title: verifier_report
description: Output from the Verifier agent: the warnings report consumed by the orchestrator (which runs the auto-fix loop for fixable warnings and halts on hard warnings), the Fleet View builder (for the status chip + count), and the HTML splicer (for the inline Reviewer flags section). Schema locked 2026-05-21; severity enum updated for the auto-fix model (Decision 18).

report_id.description: Internal handle for the report (not user-facing). Used to link this warnings report to its config and per-report dashboard.

status.description: Overall outcome at the end of the run (after the auto-fix loop). pass = no warnings, OR all fixable warnings were resolved by the auto-fix loop. warn = at least one hard error exists but every hard error has been overridden by the reviewer; dashboard publishes with inline reviewer flags. fail = at least one un-overridden hard error remains; dashboard not generated.

checks_run.description: Identifiers of the checks the verifier executed (e.g. 'methodology_compliance', 'data_sync').

summary.description: Counts at the top level for quick at-a-glance reading. Consumed by the Fleet View card to render its display string.

hard_count.description: Number of warnings with severity = hard at the end of the run. Includes fixables that were escalated to hard after exhausting their retry cap in the auto-fix loop.

fixable_count.description: Number of warnings that were classified fixable and successfully resolved by the auto-fix loop. Audit-trail signal of how many corrections the agent needed this week.

warnings.description: One entry per finding. Empty array means a clean pass.

id.description: Stable identifier for this warning (e.g. 'w1', 'w2'). Used as the target of the override CLI flag.

severity.description: hard = a claim or number that doesn't trace to the data (fabrication); pipeline halts immediately, no auto-fix attempted. fixable = a methodology compliance issue or formatting violation (missing/wrong units, framing rules, structural format); orchestrator runs the auto-fix loop, max 2 retries, then escalates to hard if unresolved.

claim.description: Exact text from the narrative being challenged.

location.description: JSON-path into narrative_blocks.json identifying where in the narrative the claim lives (e.g. 'main_conclusions.bullets[2].body').

issue.description: What the verifier thinks is wrong, in a sentence.

evidence.description: The CSV value, methodology rule, or other anchor the verifier compared against.

rule_id.description: Reference to a specific methodology section (e.g. '§6.b'), or null when the warning isn't tied to a documented rule.

overridden.description: True when the reviewer has bypassed this warning via --override.

justification.description: Reviewer's reason for publishing despite this warning. Must be non-empty when overridden = true; the orchestrator's --override flag enforces this.
